attackers_goals: Access services bound to localhost. Sniff traffic on any interface on the host. Bypass network policy.
description: An identity created a Kubernetes pod attached to the host network. This may indicate an adversary attempting to access services bound to localhost, sniff traffic on any interface on the host, and potentially bypass the network policy.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Inspect for any unusual access to localhost services. Inspect for any network sniffing tool being used inside the Kubernetes Pod.
